title: Out of office
paragraphs: I like to keep moving: basketball, bouldering, skiing when the season allows.
I'm usually the one organising things, from a weekend in the Ardennes to a barbecue in the garden. Time with friends and my girlfriend recharges me, and when I want to be alone, I pick up the guitar.
photoAlt: Thomas lying in the snow next to his skis, with sunny Alpine slopes behind him
